correctness.rationale: For all connected vertex- and edge-transitive regular bases on n>=3 vertices, strict convexity of inverse trace on the zero-sum subspace proves unrestricted uniqueness. Unique optimizer must respect the automorphisms. Its exact Laplacian has eigenvalues na, (n+2)a and 2a+b*eta_i. Every base weight b strictly improves Kemeny for fixed apex weight a, so b=(1-2a)/d. With s_i=eta_i/d in (0,2], the reduced derivative is uniformly at most -4/(n+2)<0; hence a=1/n and b=(n-2)/(nd). For cycles the resolvent identity yields the exact finite sum and asymptotic coefficients; for the feasible maximum-degree walk it yields n²/(2sqrt(3)) versus n^(3/2)/2. Finite code diagnostics are nonexhaustive and not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A full, unique optimal weighted Markov chain is determined for an infinite natural two-apex network family rather than only a symmetric subproblem. The dimension-only saturation law contrasts with base-spectrum-sensitive three-phase SLEM design. The exact cyclic Kemeny formula and a sharp maximum-degree baseline ratio growing as sqrt(n/3) quantify a provably unbounded practical design penalty.
